description.en: Plan-to-run-to-verify growth workflow for DSH: a .growing/ mirror (plan, per-task retros, lessons ledger) the repository dogfoods on itself; 28 bundled skills and 4 subagent presets, plus a portable bash guard (gate-check, task-verify, next-task, doctor) with a retro gate, ranked lesson injection, and a turn-end verify-stamp guard.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 plan→run→verify 成长型开发流程：仓库自身 dogfood 的 .growing/ 镜像（计划、逐任务复盘、教训台账）；内置 28 个技能与 4 个子代理预设，外加可移植 bash 守卫（gate-check、task-verify、next-task、doctor），含复盘必交门、教训排名注入与回合收尾 verify 印记守卫。
